title: Refinery Resurrection
summary:
Croix refinery restart will impact crude and product flows
By the end of 2019, Limetree Bay Refining is planning to restart (part of) the old Hess, St. Limetree Bay is owned by a consortium of ArcLight Capital (79%), Freepoint Commodities (7%) and a syndicate of other investors. The initial processing capacity of the facility is 200,000 b/d.
